notes: Single violation-flag design. a_CHK_011 uses disable iff and covers (a),(c),(d),(e window). The second assertion a_CHK_011_rst has no disable iff and covers (b), the strap quiet period and (f). It shares fails_CHK_011 and has no separate hits counter. (e) counts unchanged i_gpio across edges, including edges before release. Strap-dependent terms are inactive when GpioAsHwStrapsEn=0, and (f) is inactive when GpioAsyncOn=1. I have not compiled this in Verilator.
